name: Lisa Doyle
source: A student of the protagonist class, she has albinism and has suffered bullying as a result. Lisa was very attached to her father, who gave her the emotional support she needed as a child. After he was killed by a drunk driver, she told herself she was over it, despite continuing to think of any men in her life as potential father figures.
